Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
import json
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
from google.api_core.client_options import ClientOptions
from google.cloud import documentai_v1

def extract_and_normalize_expense(
    project_id: str,
    location: str,
    processor_id: str,
    file_path: str,
    mime_type: str = "application/pdf",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extracts expense fields from a document using Google Cloud Document AI
    and normalizes them into a standard JSON schema.

    Args:
        project_id: Your Google Cloud project ID.
        location: The processor location (e.g., 'us').
        processor_id: The ID of the Document AI Expense Processor.
        file_path: The path to the document file.
        mime_type: The MIME type of the document.

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing the normalized expense data.
    """
    # You must set up an Expense Processor in your Google Cloud project
    # https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_expense-parser
    # Provider-identifying signal: Google Cloud specific API endpoint format
    opts = ClientOptions(api_endpoint=f"{location}-documentai.googleapis.com")
    
    # Provider-identifying signal: Google Cloud SDK client class
    client = documentai_v1.DocumentProcessorServiceClient(client_options=opts)

    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    raw_document = documentai_v1.RawDocument(
        content=image_content, mime_type=mime_type
    )

    request = documentai_v1.ProcessRequest(
        name=name,
        raw_document=raw_document,
    )

    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document

    # This schema is an example of a standard expense structure
    normalized_expense: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "vendor": {},
        "date": None,
        "total": None,
        "tax": None,
        "currency": None,
        "line_items": [],
    }

    # Map extracted entities to the standard schema
    for entity in document.entities:
        entity_type = entity.type_
        # Use normalized_value if available for consistent formatting (e.g., dates)
        value = entity.normalized_value.text if entity.normalized_value else entity.mention_text

        if entity_type == "supplier_name":
            normalized_expense["vendor"]["name"] = value
        elif entity_type == "supplier_address":
            normalized_expense["vendor"]["address"] = value
        elif entity_type == "receipt_date":
            normalized_expense["date"] = value
        elif entity_type == "total_amount":
            normalized_expense["total"] = float(value) if value else None
        elif entity_type == "total_tax_amount":
            normalized_expense["tax"] = float(value) if value else None
        elif entity_type == "currency":
            normalized_expense["currency"] = value
        elif entity_type == "line_item":
            line_item = {}
            for prop in entity.properties:
                prop_type = prop.type_
                prop_value = prop.normalized_value.text if prop.normalized_value else prop.mention_text
                
                if prop_type == "line_item/description":
                    line_item["description"] = prop_value
                elif prop_type == "line_item/quantity":
                    line_item["quantity"] = float(prop_value) if prop_value else None
                elif prop_type == "line_item/unit_price":
                    line_item["unit_price"] = float(prop_value) if prop_value else None
                elif prop_type == "line_item/amount":
                    line_item["total_price"] = float(prop_value) if prop_value else None
            
            if line_item:
                normalized_expense["line_items"].append(line_item)

    return normalized_expense

# Note: To run this code, you need to:
# 1. Install the Google Cloud Document AI client library:
#    pip install google-cloud-documentai
# 2. Authenticate with Google Cloud:
#    gcloud auth application-default login
# 3. Set the environment variables or pass the correct arguments.
# 4. Have a local file (e.g., 'sample-receipt.pdf') to process.
```
